story: Rosie waited nine months at the shelter. Then the Alvarez family met her at an adoption event.
testimonial: Rosie made our quiet house feel like home again. It was the best choice we ever made.

story: Tobias is an older cat with a heart condition. The Chen family wanted to give an older cat a soft, loving home.
testimonial: People said older cats are hard to place. Tobias proved them wrong, in the best way.

story: Scout was shy at first. Kind shelter volunteers helped him feel safe before he found his home.
testimonial: Scout hid under the couch for a week. Now he greets every guest at the door.
